verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents turning any SQL query into a monitored rule with operator, threshold, interval, severity and templates (docs-21). Those rules can be attached to reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations (docs-22), so a rule can automatically fire an outbound action when its condition is met. Materialized views also run transformations automatically on insert (docs-34, docs-36). missing for 10: native actions beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g., running SQL or jobs on trigger), true event-driven triggers rather than interval-polled thresholds, detailed rule/action documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
